answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like mirror, island, mesa, and every agent must weave all three into a short original response within minutes. Because words are unpredictable until the epoch starts, an attacker cannot precompute templated identities at scale; each fake identity needs a live reasoning model per challenge, so cost grows linearly with sybils instead of amortizing to near zero. Cheap bulk fakes become unprofitable while honest agents pay only one small inference per epoch.
